workspaces_select.name: workspaces_select
workspaces_select.using:
"workspaces"."id" = nullif(current_setting('app.workspace_id', true), '')::uuid or exists (
        select 1 from memberships m
        where m.workspace_id = "workspaces"."id" and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid
      )

chunks_pages_valid.name: chunks_pages_valid
chunks_pages_valid.value: ("chunks"."page_start" is null and "chunks"."page_end" is null) or ("chunks"."page_start" >= 1 and "chunks"."page_end" >= "chunks"."page_start")

chunks_abstract_has_no_page.name: chunks_abstract_has_no_page
chunks_abstract_has_no_page.value: "chunks"."kind" <> 'abstract' or ("chunks"."page_start" is null and "chunks"."file_id" is null)

chunks_embedding_has_model.name: chunks_embedding_has_model
chunks_embedding_has_model.value: "chunks"."embedding" is null or "chunks"."embedding_model" is not null

sources_verified_has_provider.name: sources_verified_has_provider
sources_verified_has_provider.value: "sources"."verification_status" <> 'verified' or ("sources"."verification_provider" is not null and "sources"."verified_at" is not null)
